findings.title: Invalid Ruby syntax `<%- end if %>` causes a SyntaxError when rendering `embed/best`
findings.body: Line 6 closes the `if @topic_view.posts.present?` block with `<%- end if %>` instead of `<%- end %>`. In Ruby/Erubis, `end if;` is not valid syntax for closing an `if` block and raises a `SyntaxError` whenever `app/views/embed/best.html.erb` is compiled/rendered. (This was not caught by `embed_controller_spec.rb` because RSpec controller specs do not render views by default.)

findings.title: `i.content.scrub` raises `NoMethodError` on RSS 2.0 feeds and Ruby < 2.1
findings.body: In `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed`, line 35 calls `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. With `SimpleRSS`, standard RSS 2.0 items populate `i.description` (or `i.content_encoded`) rather than `i.content` (which is an Atom element), so `i.content` is `nil` and calling `.scrub` on it raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'scrub' for nil:NilClass`. Additionally, `String#scrub` was only introduced in Ruby 2.1 and will raise `NoMethodError` on Ruby 2.0/1.9.

findings.title: Unescaped `url` and unsanitized HTML stored with `cook_method: raw_html` allow Stored XSS
findings.body: `TopicEmbed.import` appends `#{url}` to `contents` without escaping `url` and creates the post with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, which causes `Post#cook` to return `raw` directly and bypass `PrettyText` HTML sanitization. Because Ruby's `URI.parse` allows single quotes (`'`) in URLs, an attacker can request `/embed/best?embed_url=http:///valid-path?x='onmouseover='alert(1)` (with a matching `Referer` header), passing `URI(@embed_url).host` validation in `TopicRetriever` and injecting arbitrary attributes/HTML into the created forum post. In addition, `Jobs::PollFeed` passes raw unescaped feed HTML directly to `TopicEmbed.import` without sanitization, and `contents << ...` mutates the caller's string in place (failing if `contents` is `nil` or frozen).

findings.title: `invalid_host?` and `TopicEmbed.import_remote` do not validate URI scheme or nil host before calling `open`
findings.body: In `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`, `SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host` does not check that `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` is present or that the URI scheme is `http`/`https`. If `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` is `nil`, any relative URI or file path (such as `"/etc/passwd"` or `"not_a_url"`) has `URI(@embed_url).host == nil`, so `nil != nil` evaluates to `false` (valid). Even when `embeddable_host` is set, non-HTTP schemes such as `ftp://<embeddable_host>/...` or arbitrary ports pass `invalid_host?` and are passed to `open(url).read` in `TopicEmbed.import_remote` (line 48) before `TopicEmbed.import` ever checks `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`. Furthermore, `fetch_http` on line 49 calls `SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase` without checking if `embed_by_username` is `nil`.

findings.title: `TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls` corrupts protocol-relative URLs starting with `//`
findings.body: `absolutize_urls` checks `href.start_with?('/')` (and `src.start_with?('/')` on line 70) and rewrites the attribute to `"#{prefix}/#{href.sub(/^\/+/, '')}"`. Protocol-relative URLs such as `//cdn.example.com/image.jpg` start with `'/'`, so `absolutize_urls` strips the leading `//` and prepends the article's host prefix, turning them into broken URLs like `http://eviltrout.com/cdn.example.com/image.jpg`.

findings.title: `TopicEmbed.import` raises `NoMethodError` when updating an embed whose post was deleted
findings.body: neither `Topic` nor `Post` destroys associated `TopicEmbed` records on deletion, and `Post` includes `Trashable` (which scopes out soft-deleted posts). If an imported topic or post is deleted by a moderator, `embed = TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first` will still be found on subsequent imports, but `embed.post` will be `nil`. When the remote content changes, `PostRevisor.new(post).revise!` on line 36 will raise `NoMethodError: undefined method 'raw' for nil:NilClass`.

findings.title: `loading` response is cached for 1 minute while `loading.html.erb` reloads after 30 seconds
findings.body: `EmbedController#best` calls `discourse_expires_in 1.minute` unconditionally, including when `topic_id` is `nil` and the `loading` template is rendered. However, `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb` schedules `document.location.reload()` after 30 seconds (`30000` ms). Because the `loading` response has a 60-second `Cache-Control: public, max-age=60` header, the 30-second reload will be served the stale `loading` page from cache even if the background `RetrieveTopic` job has already finished.

findings.title: `Jobs::PollFeed#feed_key` is unused, causing `TopicRetriever` to re-download and re-parse the entire RSS feed on every cache miss
findings.body: `Jobs::PollFeed#feed_key` defines a Redis key for tracking feed polling, but it is never used in `poll_feed` or `execute`. Because `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` (`lib/topic_retriever.rb:41`) invokes `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` synchronously whenever a requested `@embed_url` is not yet in `topic_embeds`, any request for an older article (not present in the current RSS feed) will synchronously download, parse, and import the entire RSS feed before falling back to `fetch_http`.
